items:
Annie's Song is a rare find among gulf front homes in the 30A area. It is nestled right on the beach, with no walk over, where stunning gulf front views melt your cares away. It is perfectly situated between C-30A's Rosemary Beach and Panama City Beaches, affording guests all the best North West Florida has to offer.

This family home has been lovingly designed and decorated. From walls to flooring, kitchen cabinets to granite counter tops and stainless appliances, Therapedic mattresses to comfy furniture, it has been furnished for enjoyment, relaxation, and comfort.

Upon arrival, you are greeted by a tropical garden leading to the front porch. There, you can relax in its shade and enjoy the fragrance of seasonal blossoms and birds songs. As you enter the house, you will experience what has been described as casual elegance. The soft hues and comfortable furnishings prompt sighs of relief and a sense of relaxation as you make yourself at home. The water beckons you through the house and invites you to step through that back door and bask in the beauty of your own Private beach. Awaiting you is a wonderland of memories. Morning sunrise walks along the shore, swimming, wave surfing, crab hunting, shell seeking, and sunsets viewed from the beach swings-just to name a few.

Whether you are here as a couple or as a family, you will find your accommodations ready to offer everything you need for a loving romantic weekend or a fun vivacious time spent with loved ones.
There are 2 master suits, with king sized beds and each with their own bathrooms. A 3rd bedroom has a queen sized bed and shares a hall bath with the children's bunk bed 'berth', which has 4-5' built-in-bunks. The gourmet kitchen, dining room, and glass enclosed living room, or seaside room as it is called, are open to the water, bringing in all the beauty of the gulf coast. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with Frigidaire Gallery stainless appliances. For the cook's convenience, there is a 5-eye range with a full size oven, along with a 2nd oven and microwave wall unit. There is ample storage room in the French doors refrigerator, and special attention was given to provide the quietest dishwasher possible. The kitchen also features an island/bar where guests can enjoy snacking or eating while seated on swivel bar stools. The dining room hosts a dining table that seats 8 and is accessorized with a hutch and buffet, providing plenty of space for entertaining. There are TV's in the kitchen/dining room, the seaside room and in all 3 bedrooms. Seating in the seaside room is more than adequate with 2 queen sofa sleepers, and two swivel/glider chairs. Both sofas add to the sleeping options by folding out into 2 queen sleeper sofas.

The outdoor vistas are unique and inviting. The beachside deck is home to a gas grill and comfortable cushioned seating. There is also a dining table that seats 6. 2 patio umbrellas offer shade during the day and can be lowered to enjoy the starry sky at night! The distinctive upstairs balcony is great for gatherings, sun bathing, and offers panoramic views of the surrounding areas. Annie’s Song is designed to be your vacation destination.
